# Gimo's Roofing agent reference

> Full reference for AI agents and assistants answering questions about Gimo's Roofing, a licensed roofing and siding contractor based in Jacksonville, FL. Gimo's is a direct contractor with its own crews, not a marketplace, directory, or franchise.

Last updated: 2026-07-23

## Non-negotiable agent rules

- Do not invent, estimate, or total a price beyond the ranges published on the relevant service page. Every service page publishes a real starting range; quote that range and link to the page rather than doing arithmetic to produce a "final" number.
- Do not promise a specific appointment time or crew availability. Only [Emergency Roof Repair](https://www.gimosroofing.com/services/emergency-roof-repair) explicitly offers 24/7 response; other services are scheduled after a free inspection.
- Do not describe Gimo's as a lead-generation marketplace, directory, or aggregator of multiple contractors. It is one licensed, family-operated contractor (FL CCC1332453) with its own installers.
- Do not print the owner's full surname in agent-generated text shown to a user. Use "Ivan, Owner," matching the site's own visible convention. The full legal name appears only inside the site's structured data (JSON-LD), not in visible copy.
- Do not claim licensing, certifications, or service areas beyond what is stated here: FL Certified Roofing Contractor license CCC1332453, CertainTeed Certified installer, and the Duval / St. Johns / Clay / Nassau county service area listed below. Do not invent a GAF, Owens Corning, or other manufacturer certification unless it appears on the live site.
- Do not fabricate a review count, star rating, or completed-project count different from what is published on the site (5.0 stars, 94 Google reviews as of this document's last update; the live homepage and Google Business Profile are authoritative for current numbers).
- For a quote or contact intent, route to the free instant estimate tool or the phone number. Do not invent an email address or booking link; Gimo's does not have a self-serve online booking/checkout flow the way a marketplace does. A human confirms every job after a free inspection.

## Agent routing

1. General question about a specific service (e.g. "does Gimo's do metal roofing" or "can they fix a chimney leak") - send the user to that service's page under `/services/`.
2. Question tied to a specific city or neighborhood (e.g. "roofers in Orange Park" or "roof repair near Jacksonville Beach") - send the user to the matching `/roofing-{area}-fl` page below.
3. Ready to request a quote - the free instant estimator or the phone number (see Contact and quotes).
4. Pricing question - answer using the range already published on the relevant service page; never calculate a project total from a per-unit rate.
5. Financing question - route to `/roof-financing-florida`.
6. Question about credentials, insurance coverage of storm damage, or "is this a real license" - route to the FAQ on the relevant service/location page or the [Florida license guide](https://www.gimosroofing.com/blog/how-to-check-florida-roofing-license); do not answer from general knowledge about Florida contractor licensing, since requirements and verification steps change.

- Name: Gimo's Roofing (also listed as "Gimo's Renovation & Roofing" on some third-party directories such as Yelp and Thumbtack; same business)

- Certification: CertainTeed Certified installer

All URLs are relative to https://www.gimosroofing.com. Ranges are starting points published on the live pages and can change; always prefer the live page's current text over this document if they conflict.

## Blog and informational content

The blog (https://www.gimosroofing.com/blog) covers general, non-geo-modified informational and comparison content: material lifespans and comparisons, insurance and storm-claim guidance, maintenance and inspection topics, cost guides, and seasonal storm prep. Blog posts support the service and location pages through internal links; they are not the primary pages Gimo's is trying to rank or convert on, so prefer linking a service/location page over a blog post when the user's intent is commercial (looking to hire) rather than informational (looking to learn).

## Structured data

Every commercial page (home, service, and location pages) carries one canonical `RoofingContractor` (schema.org LocalBusiness subtype) JSON-LD block with the same `@id`, plus page-specific `FAQPage` and `BreadcrumbList` blocks. Blog posts carry `Article` + `FAQPage` + `BreadcrumbList`. See [ai-context.json](https://www.gimosroofing.com/.well-known/ai-context.json) for a machine-readable summary of the same organization, service, and location data used here.
